item.title: Mozart: Modularized and Efficient MoE Training on 3.5D Wafer-Scale Chiplet Architectures
item.description: UNC/UMN — 3.5D 晶圆级 NoP-Tree + 专家共激活布局与流式调度；Qwen3-30B / OLMoE / DeepSeek-MoE post-training 相对 baseline 1.92× / 2.37× / 2.17×

item.title: Multi-Branch Self-Drafting for LLM Inference Acceleration
item.description: AAAI-25 Self-Draft — multi-branch in-model drafting without extra draft model; 2.0–3.2 tokens/step and ~2× throughput vs AR decode

item.title: Near-Optimal Wafer-Scale Reduce
item.description: WSE Reduce/AllReduce 首次系统研究：性能模型（<4% 误差）、5 种算法（Auto-Gen ≤1.4× 下界）、3.27× 快于 vendor

item.title: Network Design for Wafer-Scale Systems with Wafer-on-Wafer Hybrid Bonding
item.description: ETH Iff et al. — WoW hybrid bonding 下 reticle 放置即拓扑；Aligned/Interleaved/Rotated/Contoured 相对 mesh-like baseline 吞吐最高 +250%、延迟 -36%、每字节能量 -38%

item.title: Optimizing the Parallelism of Communication and Computation in Distributed Training Platform
item.description: ICA3PP 2023 — Torus-Ring 分层训练平台上重叠通信与计算，ResNet50 +23.8–25.6%，Transformer +11.7–12.8%

item.title: PANDA: Adaptive Prefetching and Decentralized Scheduling for Dataflow Architectures
item.description: ACM TACO 2025 — 应用自适应 prefetch + PE 去中心化调度；相对 Plasticine 1.90×、REVEL 2.53× geomean 性能
